notes.text: Click a step to add a hit, and drag it up or down for its velocity. **Shift**+click rolls it, **Ctrl**+click makes it a maybe, **Alt**+click ends the lane there.
The **Chain** plays C A A B. B is the fill, a snare roll of ratchets, and C brings the crash in on the bar after it.
The rim loops every 3 steps and the cowbell every 5, so they drift against the bar and meet it again after 15 bars.
